children: Intelligent Bio Solutions submitted a 510(k) to the FDA for its Intelligent Fingerprinting Drug Screening System, citing Method Comparison accuracy above 98%.
Submitted 510(k) premarket notification to FDA seeking clearance for codeine detection.
Method Comparison Study: accuracy >98%, sensitivity >94%, specificity 100% with LC‑MS/MS verification.
Clinical program: >18,000 hours data, 18 test reports, >15,000 data lines across multiple U.S. sites.
Usability, interference, precision, and cut‑off studies support workplace deployment and reproducibility.
Cybersecurity: 100% of medium‑risk issues remediated and all 19 SBOM vulnerabilities resolved per third‑party verification.
